articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually drops AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like they're sharing vacation photos. The agency tasked with cybersecurity just got schooled on basic OpSec by a fucking intern with repository access.

articles.title: Laravel-Lang PHP Packages Compromised to Deliver Cross-Platform Credential Stealer
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude AI goes full vulnerability hunting mode and discovers 10,000 critical flaws in a month. Turns out robots are better at finding bugs than humans – who could have seen that coming?

articles.title: Project Glasswing identifies over 10,000 critical vulnerabilities in first month using AI
articles.summary: LiteSpeed cPanel plugin drops a perfect 10.0 CVSS score vulnerability that hands root access to anyone who asks nicely. Maximum severity meets maximum stupidity in this privilege escalation masterpiece.

articles.title: Cisco used AI to write security incident reports, with mixed results
articles.summary: Trump Mobile website leaks customer data to anyone with basic HTTP skills. Even MAGA grifters can't secure a simple web form – the irony is almost too perfect.

articles.title: Drupal Core SQL Injection Bug Actively Exploited, Added to CISA KEV
articles.summary: TeamPCP pulls off supply chain poisoning at unprecedented scale, turning GitHub into their personal malware distribution network. Open source trust model meets reality in spectacular fashion.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates another victory for end-to-end encryption, because apparently we still need to explain why private conversations should stay private. Basic digital rights remain surprisingly controversial.

articles.title: Akamai Joins Growing Chorus of Vendors Betting Big on Secure Enterprise Browsers
articles.summary: EFF drops new guide on fighting surveillance abuses across the Americas. Turns out systematic human rights violations require systematic resistance – who would have thought?

articles.title: AI Agents Are Shifting Identity Security Budget Dynamics
articles.summary: Google's "instant" API key deletion takes up to 23 minutes to actually work. Cloud provider claims immediate deletion while keys remain active long enough to order pizza and compromise infrastructure.

articles.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin CVE-2026-48172 Exploited to Run Scripts as Root
articles.summary: Laravel-Lang PHP packages get compromised with cross-platform credential stealer. Supply chain attacks continue proving that trust is just another attack vector in modern software development.

articles.title: Ahmadinejad Is Still Bad for Iranians — and Still Great for Israel
articles.summary: ICE recruitment tweets so racist that even cops worry they'll incite neo-Nazi violence. When law enforcement thinks your social media strategy crosses the line, you've achieved peak governmental incompetence.
